description: Send the person's own report about one of the account's onboarding issues to the Spark team, with their comment. The issue card calls this when the person picks Report this issue and writes what happened; call it yourself only when the person asks you to tell Spark about an issue from get_onboarding_issues, and pass their words as the comment, not your summary. issueId is the issue's id from get_onboarding_issues. The comment is required, up to 2000 characters. Spark staff read it and follow up; it does not fix the issue, so still offer the issue's fix. An issue takes at most 3 reports an hour. Requires Write scope. Account-wide: a client-pinned credential cannot report.

comment.description: What the person wants Spark's team to know, in their words (max 2000 characters).

name: report_onboarding_issue
title: Report Onboarding Issue
